app_tagline: Multilingual AI/ML Agricultural Decision Support Platform
hero_title: Empowering Farmers with Explainable Agricultural Intelligence
hero_desc: AgriConnect provides tailored, explainable recommendations across irrigation scheduling, crop health, weather risk, and market intelligence — designed from the ground up for Indian farmers.
milestone_info: Frontend, backend, SQLite, and bilingual framework established successfully.
feature_irrigation_desc: Calculates exact water requirements based on soil, crop stage, and pump capacity.
feature_weather_desc: 5-day hyper-local forecasts paired with IMD crop-stage risk matrices.
feature_disease_desc: Incremental vision-based diagnosis connected to verified ICAR remedies.
feature_market_desc: Honest APMC mandi prices and sell-versus-store net realization trade-offs.
footer_text: AgriConnect © 2026 — Built with Rules-First Agronomy & Explainable AI
auth_modal_desc: Enter your 10-digit mobile number to access personalized agricultural advice.
consent_mandatory_label: I consent to AgriConnect storing my farm details and phone number strictly for personalized agricultural decision support under development privacy safeguards.
consent_image_label: Optional: I permit AgriConnect to use my anonymized crop photos for training agricultural models.
err_phone_invalid: Please enter a valid 10-digit Indian phone number (starting with 6-9).
err_consent_required: Data-processing consent is mandatory to create an account.
err_name_required: Farmer name is required for registration.
hint_gps_or_manual: Device GPS is optional. You can type coordinates manually or update them anytime.
gps_failed: Unable to detect GPS. Please enter coordinates manually.
hint_crop_catalog: Crops are loaded dynamically from the regional agricultural catalog.
dashboard_no_farms: No farm parcels registered yet. Click below to add your first parcel.
dashboard_no_active_crop: No active crop on this parcel. Click to register a new crop cycle.
consent_status_withdrawn: General Data Processing Consent: Withdrawn (Advisory Suspended)
consent_withdrawn_warning: Warning: Data processing consent is currently withdrawn. All automated advisory and personalized farm calculations are suspended. Your farm records are kept safe in a dormant state until you re-enable consent or delete your account.
toggle_image_consent: Permit anonymized crop image model training
confirm_withdraw_consent: Are you sure you want to withdraw data processing consent? Personalized advisory and farm management operations will be suspended.
confirm_delete_account: Are you sure you want to permanently delete your account and all associated farms and crops? This action cannot be undone.
